items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: That's how I know them... I'd be on the street with him, let me meet them fellas... That's how I know plenty of them to him.

ctx.x: Something just on the heart of this fella.
About Arnaud? Yeah. Yeah. And was he a son of a jolly fella, you'd say?

My brother was. We'd take to meet all those different fellas. That's how I know them. What's the heck I couldn't get on? Huh? What'd he say then? I say he was a jolly fella, all the time joking and caring about. Your brother. And I'd be on the street with him, let me meet them fellas to see what he knows. That's how I know plenty of them to him. And then going around different dances, you know. Yeah. I got a hold of to know plenty of them. Yeah. And different places he'd be playing, come sit around, you know.…
